# User guide
1. Use the hosted studio or run npm run dev, then open the localhost URL shown.
2. Save a Groq key, select an available model, then click Save model.
3. Run JOGENERATE. Check each feed’s coverage and timestamp. If a live feed cannot be reached, the published candidate snapshot is used automatically. Check its retrieval date.
4. Open Repositories. Pin the list, edit the appropriate record and click Select.
5. Click Generate application, then Render & preview. Download the project ZIP when satisfied.
6. Extract the project and open its dist/index.html. The companion itself needs no service.
7. Change language from the fixed header. Arabic uses right-to-left layout. Source data and documentation retain their original language.
